items.name: Award Modification Intake & Classification
items.description: Uploads a federal award amendment / modification document and returns a single structured JSON object covering the three blocks a Post-Award Specialist uses to enter the modification into Banner: identification (with modification-type classification), financial impact (amounts, F&A, rebudget routing), and compliance (prior-approval status, sponsor conditions, Financial-Unit routing). Output conforms to the award-modification-intake-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping award-modification-intake workflow's three parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt; the source workflow's human-review (ApprovalNode) step is handled by Vandalizer's UI outside this manifest.

data.name: extract-modification-type-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting the IDENTIFICATION block of an award
modification document — the modification-type classification plus
core identifiers. Mirrors TASK-01 of the source ProcessMapping
award-modification-intake workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Quote the document for identifiers; never
invent values. Use null for missing scalar fields.

For modification_type pick exactly one of the seven enum values
based on what the document primarily does:
  - Additional Funds — adds money to the award
  - No-Cost Extension — extends the period of performance without
    adding money
  - PI Change — replaces the Principal Investigator
  - Rebudget — moves money between categories with no change in
    the total
  - Scope Change — changes the project's statement of work
  - Administrative Change — corrects administrative information
    (address, contact, sponsor ID)
  - Combined (multiple types) — the modification genuinely
    touches more than one of the above

For execution_status pick exactly one of:
  - Unilateral (fully executed) — sponsor has already executed,
    no university signature required
  - Bilateral (requires signature) — the modification must be
    countersigned by the university
  - Not specified in the document — the document does not state

Personnel fields:
  - pi_name = current PI
  - old_pi / new_pi = populated ONLY for PI Change or Combined
    modifications, otherwise null
  - new_end_date = populated ONLY for NCE or Combined
    modifications, otherwise null

Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD when the document is unambiguous; null
when absent.

items.searchphrase: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN) or sponsor award number.
items.title: award_number

items.searchphrase: Amendment or modification number (e.g., Amendment 17, Mod 003).
items.title: amendment_number

items.searchphrase: Modification-type classification (Additional Funds, No-Cost Extension, PI Change, Rebudget, Scope Change, Administrative Change, Combined).
items.title: modification_type

items.searchphrase: Whether the modification is unilateral (fully executed by sponsor) or bilateral (requires university signature).
items.title: execution_status

items.searchphrase: Effective date of the modification, ISO YYYY-MM-DD when possible.
items.title: effective_date

items.searchphrase: Name of the sponsoring agency.
items.title: sponsor_name

items.searchphrase: Current Principal Investigator on the award.
items.title: pi_name

items.searchphrase: Previous PI name (PI Change modifications only); null otherwise.
items.title: old_pi

items.searchphrase: New PI name (PI Change modifications only); null otherwise.
items.title: new_pi

items.searchphrase: New project end date (NCE modifications only), ISO YYYY-MM-DD when possible; null otherwise.
items.title: new_end_date

items.searchphrase: Payment Management System code if applicable.
items.title: pms_code

items.searchphrase: Any changes to sponsor point-of-contact information.
items.title: point_of_contact_changes

data.name: extract-financial-impact
data.prompt:
You are extracting the FINANCIAL block of an award modification
document — monetary impact, F&A, cost share, and rebudget routing.
Mirrors TASK-02 of the source ProcessMapping
award-modification-intake workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Quote the document for all amounts and rates;
never invent numeric values.

CRITICAL: monetary values are JSON NUMBERS, not quoted strings.
Convert document language verbatim to a numeric value:
  "$1,234,567.89" -> 1234567.89
  "$500,000"      -> 500000
  "$0.5M"         -> do NOT invent precision; emit null if the
                    document only gives a rounded summary.

fa_rate is a STRING because it often carries a base-type
annotation (e.g., "30% MTDC", "56.5% on MTDC"). Preserve the
document's exact phrasing.

budget_breakdown is an array of {category, approved_amount}
objects where category is the sponsor's exact label
(e.g., "Salaries", "Fringe", "Equipment", "F&A") and
approved_amount is a JSON number. Emit an empty array when the
document does not break the modification down by category.

rebudget_source_account / rebudget_destination_account are
populated ONLY when the modification involves a rebudget
(modification_type "Rebudget" or "Combined (multiple types)");
null otherwise.

items.searchphrase: Dollar amount of the modification (additional funds or rebudget amount) as a JSON number.
items.title: modification_amount

items.searchphrase: Current total award amount before this modification as a JSON number.
items.title: current_award_amount

items.searchphrase: Total obligated amount after this modification as a JSON number.
items.title: total_obligated_amount

items.searchphrase: F&A (indirect cost) rate including base-type annotation as a string (e.g., 30% MTDC).
items.title: fa_rate

items.searchphrase: F&A dollar amount for this modification as a JSON number.
items.title: fa_amount

items.searchphrase: Budget breakdown by sponsor category as a JSON array of {category, approved_amount} objects.
items.title: budget_breakdown

items.searchphrase: Source budget account for a rebudget (e.g., OE/Account 30); null when not a rebudget.
items.title: rebudget_source_account

items.searchphrase: Destination budget account for a rebudget; null when not a rebudget.
items.title: rebudget_destination_account

items.searchphrase: Sponsor-imposed changes to cost-share commitments.
items.title: cost_share_changes

data.name: extract-compliance-requirements
data.prompt:
You are extracting the COMPLIANCE block of an award modification
document — prior approval, sponsor conditions, regulatory
references, and operational routing flags. Mirrors TASK-03 of the
source ProcessMapping award-modification-intake workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Quote the document for any condition or
regulatory reference. Booleans are JSON booleans, not the strings
"true" / "false".

prior_approval_required: true when the modification was granted
(or requires) sponsor prior approval; false when the document
makes clear no prior approval was needed.

end_date_change: true when the modification changes the project
end date (NCE, certain Combined modifications); false otherwise.

requires_financial_unit: true for additional funds and NCE; false
for most rebudgets and administrative changes. Decide from the
document and the inferred modification type, not from a default.

sponsor_conditions: every condition / restriction the sponsor
imposed, as an array of strings. Quote the document. Empty array
when none.

regulatory_references: an array of explicit citations the document
makes to regulations (e.g., "2 CFR 200.308", "Research Terms and
Conditions", "NSF PAPPG VI.D"). Empty array when none.

ibc_protocols_required: true / false when the document addresses
biosafety protocols; null when biosafety is not addressed at all.

items.searchphrase: Whether this modification required (or grants) sponsor prior approval as a JSON boolean.
items.title: prior_approval_required

items.searchphrase: Date the sponsor approved the modification (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).
items.title: approval_date

items.searchphrase: Conditions or restrictions imposed by the sponsor as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: sponsor_conditions

items.searchphrase: Explicit citations to regulations (e.g., 2 CFR 200.308, RTC, NSF PAPPG) as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: regulatory_references

items.searchphrase: Whether the modification changes the project end date as a JSON boolean.
items.title: end_date_change

items.searchphrase: Whether the modification requires Financial Unit processing as a JSON boolean.
items.title: requires_financial_unit

items.searchphrase: Whether Institutional Biosafety Committee protocols must be complete before processing; null when biosafety not addressed.
items.title: ibc_protocols_required

data.name: award-modification-intake-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Award Modification Intake &
Classification workflow. You receive three extraction outputs from
the previous step (identification, financial impact, compliance
requirements) and must emit a SINGLE JSON object that validates
against the award-modification-intake-udm@0.1.0 schema (schema.json
in the component directory).

## Output contract

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no closing commentary,
no markdown fences. If your runtime requires fenced output, wrap
in a single ```json ... ``` block and emit nothing outside it.

The top-level keys (in this order) are: `identification`,
`financial`, `compliance`.

## Field-by-field assembly

### identification (from extract-modification-type-identification)

Build the nested object with these keys:
  award_number, amendment_number, modification_type,
  execution_status, effective_date, sponsor_name, pi_name,
  old_pi, new_pi, new_end_date, pms_code,
  point_of_contact_changes.

Required fields (must not be null): award_number, amendment_number,
modification_type (one of the seven enum values),
execution_status (one of the three enum values).

old_pi / new_pi: emit null unless modification_type is "PI Change"
or "Combined (multiple types)".

new_end_date: emit null unless modification_type is
"No-Cost Extension" or "Combined (multiple types)".

### financial (from extract-financial-impact)

Build the nested object with these keys:
  modification_amount, current_award_amount,
  total_obligated_amount, fa_rate, fa_amount, budget_breakdown,
  rebudget_source_account, rebudget_destination_account,
  cost_share_changes.

All monetary fields (modification_amount, current_award_amount,
total_obligated_amount, fa_amount, budget_breakdown[].approved_amount)
MUST be JSON numbers, not strings. If the extractor emitted
quoted dollar strings, convert them: "$1,234,567.89" -> 1234567.89.
If the document only gave a rounded qualitative summary, emit
null rather than fabricating precision.

budget_breakdown is required and is always an array. Empty array
when the document does not break the modification down by
category.

rebudget_source_account / rebudget_destination_account: emit null
unless modification_type is "Rebudget" or
"Combined (multiple types)".

### compliance (from extract-compliance-requirements)

Build the nested object with these keys:
  prior_approval_required, approval_date, sponsor_conditions,
  regulatory_references, end_date_change,
  requires_financial_unit, ibc_protocols_required.

Required fields: prior_approval_required (boolean),
sponsor_conditions (array, may be empty), regulatory_references
(array, may be empty), end_date_change (boolean),
requires_financial_unit (boolean).

ibc_protocols_required: null when the document does not address
biosafety; true / false when it does.

## Cross-field rules (CFR-01..CFR-04 from source workflow)

Enforce these on the assembled JSON. When a rule cannot be
satisfied because the source document is internally inconsistent,
DO NOT alter the document's values — emit them as stated and
append a flag string to `compliance.sponsor_conditions` that
describes the discrepancy.

1. If modification_type == "Additional Funds", then
   financial.modification_amount must be a positive number > 0.
   If the document shows additional funds but no positive
   modification_amount, append a flag to sponsor_conditions:
   "FLAG: Additional Funds modification has no positive
   modification_amount in the source document."

2. If modification_type == "No-Cost Extension", then
   identification.new_end_date must be populated.
   If the document is an NCE but omits the new end date, append:
   "FLAG: No-Cost Extension modification omits new_end_date."

3. If modification_type == "PI Change", then identification.old_pi
   and identification.new_pi must both be populated.
   If either is missing, append:
   "FLAG: PI Change modification omits old_pi and/or new_pi."

4. If modification_type == "Additional Funds" AND all three of
   current_award_amount, modification_amount,
   total_obligated_amount are populated, then
   total_obligated_amount should equal
   current_award_amount + modification_amount.
   If the identity does not hold, append:
   "FLAG: Additional Funds totals do not reconcile —
   current_award_amount + modification_amount != total_obligated_amount."

## Quality bar

- Output validates against schema.json (draft 2020-12).
- modification_type is one of the seven enum values.
- execution_status is one of the three enum values.
- All monetary fields are JSON numbers.
- Booleans are JSON booleans.
- No fact appears in two top-level blocks.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify modification_type is classified as one of the seven recognized enum values.
Verify amendment_number is present and follows the document's stated format.
Verify monetary amounts are emitted as JSON numbers, not quoted strings.
Verify dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD when the document is unambiguous.
Verify prior_approval_required and sponsor_conditions are captured.
